title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing sports media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.


In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.


Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.
  • Build Media Relationships – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.
  • Host Press Briefings & Events – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.


Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Desenvolvimento Kotlin, Java, Python AWS - 123816
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

Kotlin, com ênfase em Java Spring Boot, Python e AWS. Requisitos Técnicos: Kotlin (Habilidade Principal). Experiência com Kotlin para desenvolvimento backend. Conhecimento em frameworks como Ktor ou Spring Boot com Kotlin. Boas práticas de programação funcional e orientada a objetos em Kotlin. - Uso de coroutines para programação assíncrona. - Testes automatizados com JUnit, MockK ou Kotest. Java + Spring Boot. Experiência com Spring Boot e seus módulos (Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud). - Uso de JPA/Hibernate para persistência de dados. - Desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e GraphQL. - Testes com JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers. Python. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário para **scripts, automação e integração**. - Experiência com frameworks como **FastAPI ou Flask** é um diferencial. - Manipulação de dados com **Pandas e NumPy** (caso necessário). **AWS (Cloud)** - Experiência com **AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway e IAM**. - Infraestrutura como código (**Terraform, AWS CDK ou CloudFormation**). - Monitoramento e logging com **CloudWatch**. - Conhecimento em **ECS, EKS ou Kubernetes** é um diferencial. **Outros Conhecimentos Desejáveis** - Experiência com **CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)**. - Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**. - Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**. - Containers e Docker. - Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Principais Responsabilidades do Desenvolvedor 1. Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend Criar e manter microsserviços escaláveis usando Kotlin (Spring Boot). Projetar e desenvolver APIs REST e GraphQL. Implementar boas práticas de clean code, design patterns e SOLID. Gerenciar persistência de dados utilizando PostgreSQL, DynamoDB ou MongoDB. 2. Integração com AWS e Infraestrutura Desenvolver e otimizar soluções utilizando AWS Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway e RDS. Criar pipelines de infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK). Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS CloudWatch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Gympass;

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de engenheiros seniores, você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidades.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (criação de infraestruturas e plataformas, coleta de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, criações de APIs REST, de front-ends, de testes, implementações contínuas).
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados.
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas.

O que estamos procurando:

  • Ter cursado graduação em ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes. Você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor, que pode ser front-end, back-end, infraestrutura de big data, modelo de ML...
  • Colaboração: o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact.
  • Empreendedorismo: você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.

  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

Este profissional será responsável por criar, integrar, manter e automatizar soluções utilizando técnicas de programação e aplicação de inteligência artificial, apoiando os projetos de inovação e automação de processos.

  • Desenvolver integrações entre sistemas utilizando ferramentas de automação e programação.
  • Criar e manter fluxos de automação.
  • Aplicar conceitos de inteligência artificial para otimizar e automatizar processos.

  • Propor e implementar soluções técnicas inovadoras para demandas internas e externas.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando Power BI (diferencial).


Requisitos e qualificações:


Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:


  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas (completa ou cursando).


Experiência sólida com:


  • Ferramentas e frameworks de LLMs, como OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain ,NLP, RAG, Agentes, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, entre outras.
  • Python (Scripting, APIs, integração de sistemas e com banco de dados).
  • HTML/CSS e JavaScript (desenvolvimento web).
  • Plataforma de automação n8n.
  • Banco de dados relacional PostgreSQL (Vector Store).
  • Versionamento de código-fonte utilizando Git.
  • Criação e integração de APIs REST/SOAP.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em modelagem de banco de dados e estruturas SQL.

  • Conhecimentos em Power BI (construção de relatórios e dashboards).
  • Experiência com outras linguagens de automação ou integração de processos (Node.js, JavaScript, etc).
  • Conhecimento em N8N.

description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

description:

Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Executive Sales Representative


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule: The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary: The Executive Sales Representative will be responsible for generating leads, nurturing prospects, and closing sales for the U.S.-based companies. The ideal candidate will be results-driven, relationship-focused, and experienced in B2B/B2C sales processes. This role involves prospecting, lead qualification, product demonstrations, and maintaining client relationships to drive revenue growth in a remote environment.


Job Tasks:


  • Lead Generation: Research and identify potential customers through various channels and databases.
  • Prospecting: Conduct outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach to qualify leads.
  • Sales Presentations: Deliver product or services demos and presentations to prospects via video calls and phone.
  • CRM Management: Track leads, opportunities, and customer interactions in CRM systems.
  • Pipeline Management: Monitor sales pipeline, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing customers.
  • Market Research: Analyze market trends and competitor activities to identify opportunities.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with marketing and customer success teams to optimize sales processes.


Qualifications:


  • 1+ years of related sales experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong negotiation and closing abilities.
  • Experience with B2B or B2C sales processes.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • A quiet, private workspace with reliable internet connection.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • Video conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • WhatsApp Business
  • Sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, etc.)
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory (C1level)
  • Spanish mandatory

  • Send your easy apply

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.


This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.

  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainment

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Professor de italiano

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

description:
O Grupo NTSec é o resultado da união da ZivaSec , NTSec , InfoSec e CloudSec , empresas do mercado de tecnologia. Somos uma plataforma de soluções inovadoras em segurança, com talentos excepcionais e o compromisso de conectar o futuro dos nossos clientes à proteção que eles precisam.

Com mais de 300 profissionais que chamamos de Secpowers ⚡ espalhados em todo o Brasil e temos escritórios em Brasília (DF), Cuiabá (MT), Curitiba (PR), Fortaleza (CE), Goiânia (GO), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , estamos em constante expansão.


Reconhecidos 3 vezes pelo Great Place to Work™ , temos uma cultura forte, baseada em inovação, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade e respeito .


Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, essa vaga pode ser sua!


Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor de novas soluções e integrações com Inteligência Artificial para fazer parte do nosso time de tecnologia. Este profissional será responsável por criar, integrar, manter e automatizar soluções utilizando técnicas de programação e aplicação de inteligência artificial, apoiando os projetos de inovação e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão:


  • Desenvolver integrações entre sistemas utilizando ferramentas de automação e programação.
  • Criar e manter fluxos de automação.
  • Aplicar conceitos de inteligência artificial para otimizar e automatizar processos.
  • Desenvolver scripts e aplicações utilizando a linguagem de programação Python.
  • Propor e implementar soluções técnicas inovadoras para demandas internas e externas.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando Power BI (diferencial).


Requisitos e qualificações:


Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:


  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas (completa ou cursando).


Experiência sólida com:


  • Ferramentas e frameworks de LLMs, como OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain ,NLP, RAG, Agentes, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, entre outras.
  • Python (Scripting, APIs, integração de sistemas e com banco de dados).
  • HTML/CSS e JavaScript (desenvolvimento web).
  • Plataforma de automação n8n.
  • Banco de dados relacional PostgreSQL (Vector Store).
  • Versionamento de código-fonte utilizando Git.
  • Criação e integração de APIs REST/SOAP.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em modelagem de banco de dados e estruturas SQL.


É um diferencial se você tiver:


  • Conhecimentos em Power BI (construção de relatórios e dashboards).
  • Experiência com outras linguagens de automação ou integração de processos (Node.js, JavaScript, etc).
  • Conhecimento em N8N.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Mid/Senior Kotlin Software Engineer
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs.


What you will do :

  • Build and maintain REST APIs consumed by our applications.
  • Work with PostgreSQL databases, ensuring performance and reliability.

Mid-level:

  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL (schema design, queries, optimization).

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

Senior-level:

  • Proven experience designing scalable backend architectures.

If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Gerente de PLD
description:
Sobre nós


A Kiwify é uma das maiores plataformas de infoprodutos do Brasil, possibilitando que qualquer pessoa crie e venda seus cursos online.


Somos acelerados pela Y Combinator, do Vale do Silício, e hoje já impactamos milhões de usuários.


Agora estamos dando o próximo passo e criando a Conta Digital da Kiwify, que já nasce com alcance massivo e um canal único de distribuição através dos maiores influenciadores do país.

Período

title: Software Architect .NET
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.
